items.metric: Share of teams with a 0% match win rate when down 3-9 at halftime
items.source_name: Riot Games — VALORANT Data Drop: VCT 2023
items.notes: 18 of 32 teams never won a map after a 3-9 half. A measure of how strong the economic/score snowball is at the half. Supports round-value / save-decision snowball modelling (README §20, §26.3).

items.metric: Round win rate for the team that called a tactical timeout
items.notes: Timeouts were 'not really' decisive. Weak prior for match-management timeout effects (ManagedSessionOptions.timeoutsPerHalf / moodEffects, HANDOFF §4). One event.

items.metric: Share of clutches that shifted momentum (>=2 round win streak after)
items.notes: 156 clutches: 25.6% shifted momentum to the clutcher's team, 58.3% no change, 16.0% lost momentum. Relevant to session H clutch distribution and to round-value momentum modelling.

items.metric: Match comeback rate when down 2-10 at halftime
items.source_name: Riot Games — VALORANT Data Drop: VCT 2023
items.notes: 67 games had a 2-10 half; only DRX and Team Liquid came back (~3%). 0-26 when trailing 1-11, 0-4 when trailing 0-12. Deep-deficit comeback priors for the round-value model.
